text:
aya: Kicking off kite-3b onboarding intake. Primary asks: latency targets for hosted vs dedicated, quant profiles to evaluate (int8/int4), and a checklist for canary + fallback.

sam: ETA for initial evals? can run perf suite tomorrow morning.

maria: I can run the Evals harness (generation + safety + logprob diffs). Need the model artifact & quant configs.

aya: Artifact is in gcs: gs://redwood-models/kite3b/release/candidate-v1.tar.gz. Quant configs: start with O2-int8 then int4-ptq. list of experiments attached below.

liam: quick note on deployment modes: Hosted -> enforce 150ms p95 for 512 tokens (target), Dedicated -> 80ms p95 on same hw. Private SLA negotiable.

nora: For canary, prefer traffic steering by API key (customer test traffic) + 0.1% random for smoke. Keep metrics auto-monitoring on cost and hallucination rate.

aya: Proposed canary plan (suggested):
```
- Phase A: 0.1% (smoke) -> 1 hour
- Phase B: 1% -> 4 hours
- Phase C: 5% -> 12 hours
- Phase D: 20% -> 24 hours
- Full: 100% after stability gating
```

sam: Add immediate rollback triggers: error rate > 2x baseline OR safety violation spike > 0.1% OR quality regression (BLEU/ROUGE/logprob) beyond configured thresholds.

maria: Defining quality gates:
- sample-based evals vs gold prompts (N=200) -> mean ROUGE delta <= 1.5 points
- logprob shift mean <= 0.25
- toxic-safety false positive/negative checks (no increase > 0.05)

liam: Also watch KV cache memory usage; quant int4 increases compute but may increase sequence memory pressure. Add memballoon smokes on long contexts.

nora: For hosted fallback policy: primary -> kite3b-int8, fallback -> kite3b-int4 (if cost or capacity), final fallback -> raven-lite-4b (lower quality but stable). For dedicated/private, prefer model pins and local fallbacks.

deploy-bot: Canary job created: canary/kite3b/candidate-v1 at 1959994350. Logs: /deploys/kite3b/candidate-v1/canary.log

aya: Warmup plan: pre-warm KV cache with 100 curated prompts covering common prefix lengths + long-tail cases. Use scripted seq lengths: 64, 256, 1024.

sam: Perf test commands I used: 
```bash
run_perf --model kite3b --batch 8 --seq 512 --reps 100 --quant int8
```
Add p95/p99 to dashboard.

maria: Running quality eval now. Will post the CI artifact (eval.json) and a short summary. If regressions show up, we gate and run int4/PTQ baseline.

nora: Security & privacy note: for Private deployments, ensure KMS keys present and audit logging enabled before traffic. Don't enable canary in private until audit logs show encryption at rest.

sam: Found a small perf regression on int4 in beam search mode (p95 +30%). Repro steps in the log snippet.

maria: If beam search causes regressions, try greedy with reranker and rerun evals. Also check tokenizer differences between open-source checkpoint and our serving tokenizer.

aya: Action items: 
- sam: full perf matrix (int8/int4, seq 64/256/1024) by EOD tomorrow.
- maria: quality eval N=200 + safety checks in 6h.
- liam: rollout policy + fallback scripts & autoscale guardrails.
- nora: privacy checklist for private deployments.

qa-bot: Smoke tests scheduled at 1959994365, 30m window. Will report pass/fail.

deploy-bot: Canary metrics streaming -> dashboard: /dashboards/kite3b/canary-metrics

aya: Thanks — let's post quick results to this thread and if green we start Phase A at 60m. :thumbsup:
